bound.walk: copy printed collection GET paths from the official Fartøyregisteret OpenAPI; skip templated paths
bound.how: pda ingest --source fiskeridir --limit 10. The official OpenAPI prints /vessel-api/api/v1/vessels as a collection GET. The adapter copies that printed path joined to the OpenAPI origin. The live spec also prints /vessel-api/api/v1/vessels/{id}; that templated path is skipped.

discarded.why: HTTP 200 HTML. Do not wrap HTML docs. The vessel-api OpenAPI already lists endpoints as JSON.

HTTP 200 swagger 2.0 with 22 GET paths. Several collection GETs return 200, but Frequency measurements are empty without a time window, AsPng is image bytes, and GetLatestDetailedOverview prints many empty value fields. Fartøyregisteret printed named vessel records with a license URL.
HTTP 200 OpenAPI. /catalog/v1/items returns catalog items, but /catalog/v1/aggregations is HTTP 500. Search API, not a register list. License not printed.
HTTP 401 missing subscription key. Do not invent a token.

methods.why: Fartøyregisteret prints vessel names (name plus registrationMark). That is not a numeric time series. methods.clean drops the rows because they have no period. methods/ was not edited.

notes: Ids are copied from the printed last path segment vessels. access_path is the printed path joined to the OpenAPI origin. No Fiskeridirektoratet id was written onto a datanorge row.
Fetch GETs the stored collection URL. Observation values are printed name. Nested objects such as owners are not copied as dimensions.
License is copied from the printed OpenAPI info.license.url. Publisher stays null: the spec does not print a publisher name.
The HTML API catalog was not wrapped. Entur GBFS stayed on main (PR 61). This source does not re-implement it.
